text_block_list.text:
Wishing to make this race her last before 
setting sail on the Bakushin Road, Sakura 
Bakushin O—

On the dream stage that every sprinter 
yearns for... she clashes with a 
formidable rival: Nishino Flower!

The Trainer sent her off, wishing with all 
their heart that a further matured version 
of her would run upon this stage again 
next year.
